# Health, Energy & Readiness

This is the domain map for health, energy, readiness, habits, burnout, longevity, sleep, recovery, and wellness-related work.

## Why this matters

Health is not only a private self-improvement topic. In this vault it connects personal energy, identity-based discipline, workforce readiness, corporate wellness, ageing, resilience, and the built environment.

The useful posture is evidence-aware and practical: capture personal experiments in `raw/`, compile durable lessons into the wiki, and send public-use health or market claims to [Claim Review](/wiki/claim-review).

## Current map

| Page | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [Health & Discipline](/wiki/health-and-discipline) | Personal habits, circadian leverage, discipline, and energy management. |
| [Corporate Wellness Opportunity Strategy](/wiki/corporate-wellness-opportunity-strategy) | Business-development and market-intelligence lens on wellness, readiness, and workforce risk. |
| [Impostor Syndrome](/wiki/impostor-syndrome) | Identity lag, over-preparation, role transition, and self-trust. |
| [Open Loops](/wiki/open-loops) | Health experiments and unresolved questions. |
| [Claim Review](/wiki/claim-review) | Health, wellness, GLP-1, burnout, and market-size claims needing verification. |

## Practical questions

- What improves energy reliably enough to become a personal operating rule?
- Which health claims are durable enough to act on?
- Which wellness claims are market leads rather than verified facts?
- Which personal experiments should be captured as typed raw sources?
